role.altitude: The officer stops building worklists and matching payments by hand. They run the order-to-cash rules: reminder sequences, credit holds, priority thresholds, and the dispute causes they report back to sales and operations. Their time goes to the conversations and escalation decisions that move DSO.
reach: Bookkeeper (accounts payable and receivable): learn the AFAS bank-matching rules and share ownership of the exceptions queue
FP&A Analyst: feed promise-to-pay dates and dispute status into the weekly cash-in forecast
Controller: learn month-close provisioning for doubtful debts so write-off proposals fit the close
skills_to_grow: Setting and tuning AFAS dunning and bank-matching rules
Reading a Power BI receivables dashboard and setting priority thresholds
Dutch B2B collection law: BW 6:119a interest, the EUR 40 compensation, Wki registration of agencies
Finding the root causes of disputes with sales and operations
Reviewing model-drafted mails quickly and spotting errors
role.ambitious_version: A weekly cash-in forecast per customer, built from promise-to-pay dates, payment behaviour and open disputes. The collections officer owns it and FP&A uses it. A monthly dispute-cause report goes with it, so sales and operations can fix pricing, surcharge and proof-of-delivery problems at the source.

tasks.short: Find overdue customer accounts in AFAS, build a chase list in Excel and track follow-up.

steps.what: Run AFAS ageing report and export open items to Excel
Add promises, disputes and notes from the mailbox to the worklist

loop.input: inbound debtor mail in the collections mailbox
loop.output: tag (promise to pay, dispute, remittance, other), invoice numbers, promise date
loop.check: invoice numbers must exist in AFAS for that debtor; amounts and dates must parse; otherwise the mail goes to the unclassified queue
loop.stop: one pass per mail, one retry on a schema error, then the unclassified queue for the officer
loop.why_not_simpler: customers write free text in Dutch and English with no fixed format; keyword rules miss most promises and disputes

steps.what: Decide which accounts to chase first and how
Check KvK and credit insurer signals for risky debtors
Report overdue status to controller and sales

tasks.design: A scheduled Python job on the governed data platform reads open items from the AFAS API each morning, adds mail tags from a bounded model step that reads the collections mailbox, and scores priority with fixed, transparent rules (amount, days overdue, broken promises, KvK change). The priority list and ageing views live in the existing Power BI finance workspace. The Excel worklist and the mailed report go away.
tasks.previous_blocker: The mailbox held the promises and disputes, and only a person could read it, so the worklist stayed a hand-made Excel file. Building an AFAS connector for one officer did not pay off.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes a small AFAS-to-Power BI job and a KvK check cheap to build. A bounded model step can tag debtor mails reliably enough when its output is checked against AFAS invoice numbers.
tasks.still_hard: Keeping promise and dispute status current when customers phone instead of mail. Priority rules must stay simple and explainable, and must not grow into a credit score of sole-trader hauliers, which would be high-risk under the AI Act.
tasks.human_edge: Knowing which shipper is a key account to handle gently and which one is stretching payments on purpose. That comes from relationships with sales and the customer.

ambition.what: Re-prioritise the full overdue book every morning instead of once a week from an Excel export

tasks.altitude: The officer starts each day from a ranked list with mail status already attached and spends the time on calls. They gain the right to set and change the priority thresholds with the controller.

reach.learn: How promise-to-pay dates and payment habits per customer can feed a two-to-six-week cash forecast
Which debtor fields (payment terms, contact for invoices) drive the priority rules

evidence.claim: 81% of 336 Dutch finance professionals explain DSO after the fact and 30% name manual Excel, mail and export work as the biggest cash-flow problem
Ageing, priority lists and KvK lookups fit deterministic software; call notes fit a model step
Creditworthiness scoring of natural persons is high-risk under AI Act Annex III 5(b), with duties applying from 2 December 2027
AFAS Profit offers API access to open debtor items

assumptions: Customers are mostly businesses (shippers); some are sole-trader hauliers
The collections mailbox is a shared Outlook box
Power BI already reads a nightly AFAS extract that can include open items
unknowns: Which credit insurer Noordhaven uses and whether it offers an API or alerts
How many overdue accounts there are in a typical week
Whether the OR sees mailbox processing as monitoring of staff that needs consent
research_questions: Does the nightly AFAS extract already hold open items per invoice with due dates, or does it need a new connector?
How many debtor mails a week carry a promise or a dispute, and how accurately does a model tag a sample of 200?
Does a rule-based priority list change which accounts the officer calls, compared with today's Excel list?

tasks.short: Answer customer mails and calls about invoices, balances, payments and copies of documents.

steps.what: Read the question and identify customer and invoices

loop.output: debtor number, invoice numbers, question type (copy, statement, payment status, dispute, other)
loop.check: debtor and invoices must match AFAS; the sender's domain must match the debtor's known contacts
loop.stop: one pass plus one retry; no match or unknown sender goes to the officer's queue
loop.why_not_simpler: customers phrase questions freely and often quote shipment or order numbers instead of invoice numbers

steps.what: Look up invoice, payments, credit notes and proof of delivery
Send statements, invoice copies and payment status
Draft answers to non-standard questions

loop.input: question case and account facts from AFAS
loop.output: draft reply in the customer's language
loop.check: every amount, date and invoice number in the draft must match AFAS; the officer approves before sending
loop.stop: one draft per case, one regeneration on a failed check, then the officer writes it
loop.why_not_simpler: templates cover copies and statements but not mixed questions that need a short explanation

steps.what: Resolve real problems: disputes, wrong prices, damage claims, calls

tasks.design: A small answer desk on the shared Outlook mailbox: a bounded model step tags each mail with debtor, invoices and question type, and deterministic code fetches account facts from AFAS and proof of delivery from SharePoint or the transport system. Copies and statements go out automatically to known contacts; other replies are drafted for the officer to approve. Disputes stay with the officer, who now has the file ready.
tasks.previous_blocker: Questions arrive as free text, and the facts sit in AFAS, SharePoint and operations, so only a person could join them. Rule-based mail routing could not read the questions.
tasks.enabler_now: Models now read short business mails well, and their output can be checked against AFAS. AI coding makes the AFAS and SharePoint lookups cheap to build.
tasks.still_hard: Proof of delivery and damage records may sit in an operations system with no clean interface. Sending documents to the wrong contact is a GDPR and confidentiality risk, so the sender check must be strict.
tasks.human_edge: Hearing in a call whether a dispute is real or a stalling tactic, and agreeing a fair settlement that keeps the customer.

ambition.what: Same-day automatic reply with statement and invoice copies for every known customer contact

tasks.altitude: The officer handles only disputes and odd questions, with the file prepared. They gain the right to set which question types are answered automatically.

reach.learn: Which dispute outcomes lead to credit notes and how to request them cleanly in AFAS
How dispute causes show up in revenue and margin at month close

evidence.claim: Account questions fit an agent with a gate that sends statements, invoice copies and proof of delivery
Receivables suites claim 30% faster dispute handling, as indicative estimates only
Model-drafted business replies can be checked field by field against ledger data

assumptions: Most questions arrive by mail; a minority by phone
Invoice PDFs can be regenerated or retrieved from AFAS
Each debtor has known contact addresses in AFAS
unknowns: Where proof of delivery is stored and whether it can be fetched by order number
Share of questions that are simple copy or statement requests
Whether customers would accept automatic replies from the collections mailbox
research_questions: What share of one month's customer mails are plain requests for copies, statements or payment status?
Can proof of delivery be fetched automatically for 90% of invoices?
On a sample of 100 non-standard mails, how many model drafts pass the AFAS check and need only light edits?

tasks.short: Import Rabobank statements and match incoming payments to open invoices in AFAS.

steps.what: Import Rabobank statement into AFAS
Run AFAS auto-matching on reference, IBAN and invoice number
Match the rest using remittance mails and partial payments

loop.input: unmatched payment line, remittance mails and PDFs from the payer, open items of candidate debtors
loop.output: proposed allocation to invoices with differences
loop.check: allocated invoices sum exactly to the payment, or the difference is stated; invoices must be open for that debtor
loop.stop: one proposal per payment, one retry; no exact sum goes to the officer with candidates listed
loop.why_not_simpler: remittance advice arrives as free-text mails and PDF tables in many formats; sum-search code alone gives too many candidate combinations

steps.what: Handle short payments and unexplained receipts
Check unapplied cash and report it

tasks.design: Configure the automatic Rabobank import and tune AFAS auto-matching rules first. A scheduled job on the data platform takes the remaining unmatched lines, uses a bounded model step to read remittance mails and PDFs, and writes match proposals that the officer approves in one queue. Unapplied cash is a page in the existing Power BI finance dashboard.
tasks.previous_blocker: AFAS rules handle clean references, but customers pay several invoices at once or deduct amounts, and their remittance advice comes in mail and PDF formats that rules could not read.
tasks.enabler_now: AFAS matching rules are standard. Models can now pull invoice lists out of remittance PDFs and mails, and a sum check makes errors visible before posting.
tasks.still_hard: Short payments that hide a dispute still need a person and often a call. Some payers send no remittance at all.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising that a deduction is an unannounced damage claim or surcharge dispute and opening the right conversation.

ambition.what: Post all receipts the same day, so the ageing list and reminders never chase invoices already paid

tasks.altitude: Posting becomes a short daily review of proposals. The officer gains the right to change AFAS matching rules with the bookkeeper.

reach.learn: How the AFAS matching rules and the bank account reconciliation interact
Which unapplied cash must be cleared before close

evidence.claim: AFAS automatic matching uses payment reference, IBAN, invoice number and oldest-first sums, with misses left to a person
A receivables suite expects up to 80% touchless cash application, as indicative estimates only
A model step can read remittance mails for the remaining payments

assumptions: Rabobank statements can be imported into AFAS automatically (MT940/CAMT)
Customers mostly pay by bank transfer
The bookkeepers and collections share the receipts work
unknowns: How many receipts per month need manual matching
Whether automatic statement import is already configured
research_questions: What share of one month's receipts did AFAS match without a person, and why did the rest fail?
How many of the unmatched payments have a remittance mail or PDF that names the invoices?
On a sample of 100 unmatched lines, how many model proposals sum exactly and are correct?

tasks.short: Put non-paying customers on credit hold, inform sales and hand files to a lawyer or collection agency.

steps.what: Pick accounts that ignored all reminders and decide escalation
Set credit hold in AFAS and tell sales and operations
Build hand-over file with invoices, reminders, terms, delivery proof, interest

loop.output: one-page case summary: what was claimed, what the debtor said, promises broken
loop.check: interest (BW 6:119a) and the EUR 40 minimum are computed by code, not the model; each fact in the summary must cite a mail or AFAS record; the officer approves
loop.stop: one draft, one regeneration on a failed citation check, then the officer writes the summary
loop.why_not_simpler: invoices, reminders and interest are code, but the history of a dispute sits in free-text mails

steps.what: Check agency registration and send the file
Track agency progress, receipts and write-off proposals

tasks.design: A workflow on the data platform, started by the officer's escalation decision, sets the AFAS credit hold, sends a Teams and mail notice to the account's sales and operations contacts, and assembles the hand-over file from AFAS, SharePoint and the mailbox. Code computes interest and costs; a bounded model step writes the case summary with citations. The officer approves before anything goes to the lawyer or agency; escalated cases are tracked in a Power BI page.
tasks.previous_blocker: The file pulls from AFAS, SharePoint, the mailbox and operations, and errors in interest or terms only surface in court, so it was put together by hand with care. Volumes were too low to justify a build.
tasks.enabler_now: AI coding makes a file generator cheap. Interest rules for B2B are fixed in law and easy to code, and models can summarise mail threads with checkable citations.
tasks.still_hard: Deciding when to escalate a key account, and the irreversible effect of a credit hold on operations. Since 1 October 2026 the agency's Wki registration must be checked where sole traders are involved, or collection costs cannot be claimed.
tasks.human_edge: Weighing the relationship, the customer's situation and the cost of legal steps before escalating, and talking with sales before a credit hold.

ambition.what: Review every account that passes 60 days overdue for escalation each week, instead of a few times a quarter

tasks.altitude: The officer decides escalations and approves files instead of assembling them. They gain the right to propose credit holds and write-offs directly to the controller, inside agreed limits.

reach.task: Doubtful debt provisioning and write-off approval
reach.learn: How escalated cases and write-off proposals feed the month-end provision
How credit limits and hold rules are set and signed off

evidence.claim: Syncasso turns a file into a draft summons in two minutes, reviewed by a legal professional; handling time from 165 to 62 minutes, vendor's own figure
Early file errors (first letter, interest, costs, terms) surface only in court
B2B statutory commercial interest runs from the due date or 30 days after invoice; at least EUR 40 compensation is due without a reminder
Since 1 October 2026 a debtor who is a natural person owes no collection costs or further interest if the collecting party is not registered; bailiffs and lawyers are exempt

assumptions: Noordhaven uses one or two external collection agencies or lawyers
Credit holds can be set per debtor in AFAS
Sales owns the customer relationship and must be told before a hold
unknowns: Which agency and lawyer Noordhaven uses and whether they accept digital files
Who may approve a credit hold today and above what amount
How many accounts are escalated per year
Whether contract terms per customer are stored in SharePoint
research_questions: Of the files handed over in the last year, how many had errors in interest, costs or terms found later?
Does the agency accept a structured digital file, and would it cut its intake time?
Can credit hold be set and lifted in AFAS by API with an audit trail?
